11 rule_fragments covering: budget / paycheck / invoice / debt / budget-defaults / paycheck-defaults / debt-defaults / month / finance-plan (v0.10.0) / savings-accounts (v0.10.0) / hub types. Paycheck is month-keyed: requires `month` (^\d{4}-\d{2}$), naming `^Paycheck-\d{4}-\d{2}\.md$`, optional `deposits[]` ({date, amount}); each `expenses[]` row carries a 1-based `deposit` index tying it to which check pays it. Legacy `pay_period_start`/`pay_period_end` are downgraded to optional (archived/pre-cutover notes). paycheck-defaults carries a `deposit_schedule[]` ({day, amount}) that seeds a new month's deposits. Budget fragment carries optional `debt_allocations[]` + `savings_allocations[]` arrays (finance month-reality WS2 — per-row plan/override allocations, never summed into the discretionary envelope). Validates frontmatter on per-blueprint paths via the validator mechanism.
2 rule_fragments (reader-hub path-exact, reader-article glob) validating the type frontmatter for the reader blueprint.

24 rule_fragments — largest bundle. Covers 7 atomic-note types (cowork-morning-briefing / midday-tripwire / eod-review / weekly-review / monthly-review / finance-snapshot / scheduled-jobs) + hub types + memory types.
4 rule_fragments: project / doc-note / section-hub / sub-section-hub (v0.103.0 section-hubs + breadcrumbs).

Workshop master manifest. Keys: workshop_version, blueprints[], mechanisms[], foundational_plugins. check-version-sync.js gates workshop_version vs package.json vs ranch/platform-subscription.json at preflight start.
Workshop's own subscription file (workshop dogfoods itself per build-test-verify.md). Pinned to the workshop's own manifest version. Per-vault consumer subscriptions follow the same shape.

Finance has 4 new_entity_button entries: budget / paycheck / invoice / debt. Each declares prompts[] (text/date/number/select fields), destination, frontmatter_template, inline_body. The paycheck button prompts for a single `month` (type:month, like the invoice/budget buttons) and scaffolds Paycheck-{{month}}.md with `month`, `deposits: []`, `expenses: []` — deposits are materialized on first render from the Paycheck Defaults `deposit_schedule`; each seeded expense carries a 1-based `deposit` index. entity-create@0.7.1 consumes seed_from_defaults.resolve_wikilinks (v0.108.0).

Engagement shape read out of consumer vault-config.md: {id, label, type, priorities[], rendering[], tripwire_aspects[], overrides{}, ...}. Layered preferences tree (bundle ⨁ overrides ⨁ ad_hoc → final). v0.95.0 introduced overrides; per-key wins on objects, REPLACES on arrays.

MonthlyOverview reads page.type === 'budget' + page.month + page.categories[*].actual + dv.pages('spice/finance/paychecks').where(p => p.type === 'paycheck' && !p.file.path.includes('/_archive/') && p.month === monthKey) + dv.pages('spice/finance/debts').where(p => p.type === 'debt'). Month-keyed paychecks attribute by `month`; legacy per-check notes (no `month`) fall back to the pay_period_end (start fallback) window; archived legacy notes under /_archive/ are excluded. Income = Σ deposits[].amount for the month-keyed shape, falling back to the scalar paycheck_amount for legacy notes. Paycheck expenses[*] carry a per-expense `deposit` (1-based index into deposits[]); expenses[*].debt + paid:true expected when summing debtPaid. Behavioral coverage in platform/test/run-v01103-monthly-overview.js.

FinanceMath.computePlanState(dv, monthKey) (v0.10.0) reads the type:'finance-plan' singleton (income_floor / fixed_living_monthly / attack_above_minimums / pay_periods_per_month / savings_glide / roll_freed_savings_to_attack / overflow / avalanche_order_by / attack_target_override) + debts + type:'savings-account' under spice/finance/savings + paychecks + the month's + prior month's budget. Returns { ok, envelope, savings, attack, allocation[], payoff, overflow, whatIf, applyPlan }. ok:false reason:'no-plan' when the singleton is absent (degrade-gracefully). Behavioral coverage in platform/test/run-finance-plan-state.js.

v0.1.0 — Note-per-task frontmatter (type: task). One tiny note per task under spice/tasks/task-<id>.md (path_glob 'spice/tasks/**', which also covers the _trash/ and _done/ sub-areas — trashed/done notes keep type:task so the same branch validates them). Required keys: type / title / status. Optional keys: scheduled / due / priority / project / project_slug / trip / trip_slug / source / source_note / links / created_at / completed_at. `trip` (a `[[Name]]` link display field) + `trip_slug` (plain-string filter key) are the trip-linkage parallel to project/project_slug — additive, empty-string-not-omitted. `links` is an ARRAY of markdown link STRINGS (a note link '[[Note]]', a web link '[label](url)' or '<url>') that TaskNoteView renders in a LINKS section INSIDE the card; composeNote emits it as an empty YAML flow array `[]` when none (not omitted), serialized by TaskDialog.renderNote as a JSON-compatible flow array so it round-trips through Dataview/Obsidian. composeNote writes schema-exact frontmatter (empty-string, not omitted, for blank dates; `[]` for blank links); parseNote normalizes status→open + blank dates→null + coerces links[] (strings and/or Dataview Link objects) to a clean string array via TaskEntity._normLinks. Contract encoded in TaskEntity.validatePayload (task-entity.js).

2 rule_fragments covering 3 frontmatter types. (1) path_glob spice/trips/*/*.md with frontmatter_branch: 'trip' (atlas note, filename <Trip Name>.md) requires type:trip, name, start_date (^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}), end_date (same), location; optional people[], created_at, cssclasses:[wide]. 'trip-section' (filename <Trip Name> — <Section>.md) requires type:trip-section, section_kind (enum flights|stay|packing-list|to-do|notes|custom — TripSectionKinds is the single source of truth for label/icon/order), section (display label), trip (wikilink to atlas), trip_slug (folder slug); optional created_at. (2) path_glob spice/trips/Trips.md ('trips-hub') requires cssclasses:[wide]; canonical type:trips-hub, tags:[trips-hub]. applyTripsConformanceHeal migrates legacy atlas/section names (Trip Atlas.md / Trip Flights.md) and legacy created: to created_at: ISO+TZ. Introduced v0.3.0 / workshop v0.181.0.

v0.1.0 — `links: []` frontmatter on wiki-hub / wiki-section / docs-hub / section-hub notes. Array of {url, text} entries (text defaults to url; duplicate url rejected), same shape as ProjectLinksManager's links contract but scoped to whichever hub/section note is open (not a dedicated Link Hub note). Backfilled on every existing note by install.js's _healSectionLinksFrontmatter (idempotent, quote-strip aware). v0.210: contract extended to LEAF types wiki-page + doc-note — links[] rendered as clickable cards + an '＋ Add link' pill via SectionExplorer.renderNoteLinks (invoked by WikiChromeBar/ProjectChromeBar after the bar). NOT backfilled on leaf notes: the links key is created lazily on first write via processFrontMatter.

Delivery contract v1.2.0 (BGR redesign 2026-07-25): terminal discarded status excluded from epic rollups entirely; parked slices count in a new waiting bucket that rolls up like blocked, never active. v1.1 added explicit validateEpic/validateSlice APIs and ratification receipts; the v1.0 execution-card field set remains backward-compatible. deriveEpicLifecycle stays the single source for planned/active/blocked/done state and posture.

A4 durable batch ledger v1.0.0. Stored below the Git common directory with immutable batch/attempt identity, wall-clock/card/retry/usage/intervention ceilings, exact engine and Delivery contract pins, atomic integrity-checked persistence, idempotent start/status/stop/resume controls, side-effect idempotency keys, and shadow-only unattended selection. A4 never claims or dispatches a card.

Per-card session lease on coordinator state records: lease {token, acquired_at, renewed_at, holder{host,label}}, TTL 2h from renewed_at, time-based only (coordinator processes are short-lived; pid liveness can't arbitrate). Acquired by claim/resume, required (--lease-token) + renewed by pipeline verbs, cleared on park/terminal/supervised paths, broken manually via break-lease. Audit trail in lease_breaks[]. Absent field = unleased (no migration). Registered here for discoverability, the same per-card coordinator state record also carries three other durable optional fields with independent lifecycles, all added in v0.283.0 (loop-integrity workstream 3) and all absent-means-nothing (no migration): (1) adoption {pr, merge_sha, reason, verified: 'git'|'git+gh', adopted_at} — written once by the adopt verb alongside the terminal, projectable phase 'adopted', never mutated or cleared, and the sole input to resolveSliceAuthority's adopted authority tier and effectiveProjectionMapping's demotion exemption; (2) card_note_sha — sha256 of the bytes actually on disk after any coordinator write of that card's note, stamped through the single stampCardNoteSha helper from every coordinator writer of a tracked card's note -- projectCard (including adopt's projection refresh), heal-epic-bindings --apply, the discard dependent scan, reconcile-metadata (single-card and --contract-frontmatter-restamp --apply), reconcile-dependencies --apply, and restructure (stamped in the card_path rebind, so the hash describes the bytes at the note's final path after the move; restructure's scaffold writes refuse any pre-existing target and so never touch a tracked card's note) -- so the coordinator never mistakes its own repair for a foreign write; (3) foreign_write {detected_at, expected_sha, actual_sha} — set by projectCard when the on-disk note diverges from card_note_sha (a writer outside the rail: KanbanStatusSync at vault boot, Obsidian Sync from another machine, a hand edit), deleted by the next projection that agrees, and surfaced by board-health's foreign_writes check for projectable phases only.

Shared autoloop CLI grammar v1.0.0. Successful mutating receipts preserve action and add ok:true plus literal-replay no_op; refusals add ok:false, no_op:false, a stable code, and a message. Mutating verbs require --json and reject unknown options before reads, locks, or writes; record-review also requires one exact expected HEAD. Exit codes are 0 success/no-op, 1 refusal/failure, and 2 usage.

Coordinator-owned Loop Station frontmatter projection. Every list is capped at 20 with an explicit overflow count; projection runs only on meaningful transitions, preserves the note body, and reads the delivery digest marker with peek semantics.

Coordinator-owned ratification inbox note under spice/projects/sauce/ratifications/*.md. Pending frontmatter requires exactly type:ratification, schema_version:1.0.0, state:pending, canonical target_card, and ISO created_at; consumption adds state:consumed plus ISO consumed_at. The embedded delivery-ratification JSON block remains governed by the Delivery registry.

Sweep-owned Board Health frontmatter projection at spice/projects/<slug>/Board Health.md, written only by the board-health coordinator verb (report-only, board-driven). Five capped lists, each with an explicit overflow count: untracked_members, unprojectable_epics, lane_divergence, projection_errors, and foreign_writes (records carrying a live foreign_write finding — a tracked card's note changed on disk since the coordinator's own recorded hash; ledger-driven, cleared once the projection resyncs). The payload deliberately carries NO timestamp: unchanged findings preserve the note byte-for-byte with zero writes, so mtime means when board health last changed. Scaffold-once body (BoardHealth customjs-guard); thereafter frontmatter only; a body-only note fails closed into the receipt's note_error.

v0.266 loop plugin — per-repo `.loop/config.json` binding contract (repo → vault/board/policy). schema_version 1.0.0; resolver+validator is loop-config.js (resolve/check verbs, refusal-coded envelope). Feeds DELIVERY_* and SAUCE_LOOP_* env seams.
